Module.Name: rlm-aihub
Module.Description: AI Hub support for rlm-core: an RLM.LLM provider built on %AI.Provider.ChatComplete, so a decomposition runs through the provider an IRIS instance already has configured — no URL, no bearer token, no SSL configuration from the caller — and under the instance's own authorization and audit policies. Requires an IRIS with %AI.*; rlm-core itself needs none of it. Built on ChatComplete rather than %AI.Agent because the design is one bounded round-trip per decision and an agent tool loop is neither budgeted nor replayable.
